claims.claim: The statutory requirements are subject to an exception when another statute requires otherwise.
claims.quote: Except as otherwise required by statute,

claims.claim: The summons must be directed to the defendant.
claims.quote: a summons shall be directed to the defendant

claims.claim: The clerk must sign the summons.
claims.quote: signed by the clerk

claims.claim: The summons must be issued under the seal of the court where the action is pending.
claims.quote: issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending

claims.claim: The summons must contain the court's title.
claims.quote: (1) The title of the court in which the action is pending.

claims.claim: The summons must contain the parties' names.
claims.quote: (2) The names of the parties to the action.

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written pleading with the court in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint

claims.claim: The direction must specify filing within 30 days after the summons is served on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The notice must say that failure to respond will lead to default being entered upon the plaintiff's application.
claims.quote: A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff

claims.claim: The notice must say the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint

claims.claim: The notice must identify wage garnishment, taking money or property, or other relief as possible results.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

claims.claim: The quoted statement about seeking and promptly consulting an attorney is required in boldface.
claims.quote: (5) The following statement in boldface type:  “You may seek the advice of an attorney in any matter connected with the complaint or this summons. Such attorney should be consulted promptly so that your pleading may be filed or entered within the time required by this summons.”

claims.claim: The introductory legend must be at the top, above all other matter.
claims.quote: at the top of the summons above all other matter

claims.claim: The legend must be in boldface.
claims.quote: in boldface type, in English and Spanish:

claims.claim: The legend must appear in English and Spanish.
claims.quote: in English and Spanish:

claims.claim: The draft quotes the required English legend, including its 30-day warning.
claims.quote: “Notice!  You have been sued.  The court may decide against you without your being heard unless you respond within 30 days.  Read information below.”

claims.claim: A county may by ordinance require the legend in any additional foreign language on every summons issued out of its courts.
claims.quote: (b) Each county may, by ordinance, require that the legend contained in paragraph (6) of subdivision (a) be set forth in every summons issued out of the courts of that county in any additional foreign language, if the legend in the additional foreign language is set forth in the summons in the same manner as required in that paragraph.
claims.note: The authority is conditional: the additional-language legend must appear in the same manner required by (a)(6).

claims.claim: A summons in a Judicial Council-approved form is deemed to comply with the section.
claims.quote: (c) A summons in a form approved by the Judicial Council is deemed to comply with this section.

claims.claim: SUM-100 is a Judicial Council summons form.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons)

claims.claim: The cited form is revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: SUM-100 [Rev. July 1, 2009]

claims.claim: The form's notice begins with the heading “NOTICE! You have been sued.”
claims.quote: NOTICE! You have been sued.

claims.claim: The form has a case-number field.
claims.quote: CASE NUMBER:

claims.claim: The form has a field for the court's name and address.
claims.quote: The name and address of the court is:

claims.claim: The form has a field for the name and address of the plaintiff or the plaintiff's attorney.
claims.quote: The name, address, and telephone number of plaintiff's attorney, or plaintiff without an attorney, is:
claims.note: The field identifies the attorney if the plaintiff is represented and the plaintiff otherwise.

flags.text: The county-ordinance sentence omits §412.20(b)'s condition that the additional-language legend also appear at the top, above all other matter, in boldface.

result.summary: The sources support the summons requirements and SUM-100 details apart from the omitted condition on a county's additional-language legend.
